title: Bacteria Species, Fiber Intake, And Antibiotic Prescriptions Split Hadza And Americans
hook: Food and medicine expose why one gut community is far richer.
closing: Fiber intake and antibiotic prescriptions both shape the bacteria people carry.
question: How much fiber did you eat?

segments.say: The Hadza carry about 730 gut bacteria species. That is far richer than the average American gut.
Hadza fiber intake reaches 150 grams daily. Their gut bacteria receive far more fiber than the American average.
Likely unnecessary prescriptions make up 34% of outpatient antibiotics. Antibiotic exposure adds another pressure beyond fiber intake.
